records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md
records.summary: Quipu is a governed, bitemporal knowledge store with provenance and SPARQL access through command-line, REST, Rust library and MCP interfaces.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fsharing%2Findex.md
records.summary: Repository pendants transfer source-bound knowledge between stores through explicit quarantine and promotion, keeping transport separate from receiver authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Fmain.rs
records.summary: The native command-line entrypoint parses local query, share, import and validation commands.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Flib.rs
records.summary: The Rust library exposes the embedded graph engine used by native clients and repository integrations.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#wire-it-into-your-agent
records.summary: Agent clients connect through quipu mcp stdio or the native server streamable HTTP endpoint at /mcp.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fsharing%2Findex.md
records.summary: Imported knowledge stays staged until explicit promotion. Bundled shapes and source evidence are not automatic receiver authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#first-success-in-three-commands
records.summary: Start with the documented local first-success commands, then validate behavior on your own source data.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#before-you-start
records.summary: Check supported release platforms and the native CLI and server feature requirements before choosing an installation.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/scripts%2Fbuild-repository-share.sh
records.summary: The legacy trusted-host repository builder invokes the Bobbin indexer and Quipu share and quarantine checks. Private publication policy remains outside the public artifact.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#on-your-own-data
records.summary: After a local first success, follow the documented source-data import path; public examples are not production admission.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Finstallation-reference.md#run-it-anywhere
records.summary: The native quipu-server exposes REST, MCP at /mcp and a web interface over the same graph engine.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Fconfig.rs
records.summary: Configuration gives command flags precedence over project TOML, global TOML and built-in defaults.
